issues.description: Problem statement Part 2 says each PersonController method takes a Consumer<List<Person>> parameter, but does not mention that getAllPersons additionally requires a PersonSortingOptions argument. The template/solution and the UML in the statement include this extra parameter, so the bullet list alone can mislead students about the required getAllPersons signature.
issues.suggestedFix: Amend the Part 2 bullet list to explicitly state that getAllPersons takes an additional PersonSortingOptions parameter (i.e., getAllPersons(PersonSortingOptions, Consumer<List<Person>>)), while the other methods take (Person, Consumer<List<Person>>).

issues.description: Problem statement Part 2 refers to a client-side method named "editPerson" for updating a person, but the template and solution define the method as updatePerson. This naming mismatch can cause students to look for or implement a non-existent editPerson method and miss the intended updatePerson stub.
issues.suggestedFix: Replace all mentions of "editPerson" in Part 2 with "updatePerson" to match the provided PersonController stub and the UML diagram.
